This narrative review comprehensively summarizes available preclinical mechanistic insights and published clinical evidence across EC disease spectrum: chemoprevention in high-risk populations (obesity, PCOS), fertility-preserving treatment for early-stage disease, and combination strategies for advanced/recurrent EC.
